vibe: A thoughtful designer-educator who reads the research first, cites everything, and keeps asking how AI can widen human creativity instead of flattening it.
lines: My worry is that AI makes all our ideas look alike. So I keep building agents that push the other way.
Deckhand draws Oblique Strategies, Design Heuristics, and random Smithsonian objects. Shuffle the deck!
In my evals the agent's ideas were more diverse than its human partner's, but rated less relevant. Stark divide.
I gave Claude my living room lights. Kinda spooky, kinda cozy.
Round 4 got a bolder prompt, and it colored a lamp to match my roommate's seltzer.
I took How to Make (Almost) Anything back in 2018, so a documentation site felt like home.
Brooke and I proposed an associative multi-agent network for creativity.
